Business Travel Planner.whatItDoes: Front door for business travel questions. It routes sightseeing and work-life questions to its child agent Work life balance Buddy, transport to Transportation Agent, a health check before a trip to Health Advisor and expense refunds to Travel Expense Refund, and answers event questions from the Dataverse Event table.

Claim-Reporter.whatItDoes: Reads an uploaded invoice with the Extract Data from Invoice prompt and returns vendor, date, line items and total as JSON. The Report Claim topic ends after the extraction, so nothing is confirmed or saved.

Compliance Agent.whatItDoes: Runs a background check on a person. Its instructions collect and confirm the person's details, then hand off to the social-profiler agent in Microsoft Foundry over the Azure AI Agent Service connection. It runs on the Sonnet46 model.

Employee Agent.whatItDoes: GitHub Copilot agent with empty instructions and one SharePoint Get items tool. No site or list is set in the clone, so it has no defined job yet.
gaps: no site or list on the tool

Employee Onboarding Assistant.whatItDoes: Answers new employees' onboarding questions from the HR Documents SharePoint site, adds local tips from the Sightseeing site, and writes a personal welcome with the Employee Welcome prompt. Published to Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Food Body.whatItDoes: GitHub Copilot experiment about food: the Food MCP tool, a hello-world echo workflow, an echo-agent run on the Azure AI Agent Service, and the Sightseeing SharePoint site labelled all about food.
gaps: knowledge source does not match its description

Food Buddy.whatItDoes: Helps users pick food from the inventory. It lists food items through the Food Inventory v5 custom connector and asks the Food MCP server.

Food Inventory REST.whatItDoes: Maintains the food stock over REST: adds a food item and lists all food through the Copilot-Food-Catalog custom connector.

Food Stock Buddy.whatItDoes: Collects a restaurant's order demand on a 9-dish Adaptive Card, reads the current stock from the food catalog API, and calculates what to order with the Calculate food to order prompt.

Health Advisor.whatItDoes: First responder for health questions. It collects age, gender and symptoms, has a flow summarize them with a prompt, advises a doctor unless the outcome clears light work, explains protein types, resolves a colleague's email address and posts the case to Teams after an approval. It answers from two Word documents on fasting and traveling with health issues and serves Business Travel Planner as its symptom checker.

Health Agent v2.whatItDoes: GitHub Copilot rebuild of the Health Advisor symptom check: one instruction line that runs the CheckSymptoms workflow, which classifies age and symptoms with a Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt.

HR Buddy.whatItDoes: HR self-service. It identifies the employee (name, department, cost center) and remembers that for the conversation, submits expense claims on a card (up to 100 processed, above that sent for approval), records children, offers a reward (dinner or theatre), and answers from the HR Documents SharePoint site and the HR MCP server.

Restaurant HR Manager.whatItDoes: Plans restaurant staff: assigns employees to schedules through the Restaurant HR MCP server under structured instructions.
gaps: instructions promise to email the schedule, but no mail tool is attached

Returns Agent.whatItDoes: Autonomous returns desk. A trigger flow wakes it for each new email in the help@integrations.at shared mailbox; it checks the request against the returns-policy document on SharePoint and handles mail through the Work IQ Mail MCP server.

Transportation Agent.whatItDoes: Mock transport booker: its instructions tell it to invent bus, train or flight answers without asking for details. It exists to be the transport specialist that Business Travel Planner connects to.

Travel Agent.whatItDoes: Gives travel information from the Sightseeing SharePoint site and the web, books a trip by collecting place, date and number of people, and posts the conversation to Teams through a connector tool and the Post to teams flow.

Travel Expense Refund.whatItDoes: Expense pilot. It asks for the employee number, collects a travel claim on a 7-field Adaptive Card, builds a claim ID and ISO dates with Power Fx, and saves the claim to the Dataverse table iits_travelexpenseclaims through the Save Claim to Dataverse flow. It answers travel tax questions from a WKO public page and SharePoint through Work IQ, and serves Business Travel Planner as its expense specialist.
gaps: flow reads date and date_1, which its trigger does not define; the ISO date variables are set but not passed

sortedOut.name: Food Stock Agent
sortedOut.reason: Incomplete duplicate of Food Inventory REST: the same two operations on a twin food inventory custom connector, one-line instructions, never published.

sortedOut.name: Onboarding Agent
sortedOut.reason: Incomplete duplicate of Employee Onboarding Assistant: same HR Documents site and purpose; its only topic sends messages and its prompt writes poems.

sortedOut.name: Profile Agent
sortedOut.reason: Incomplete duplicate of Compliance Agent: the same social-profiler Foundry tool with empty instructions and description.
